title: Diwali 2026: Can You Burst Crackers on Streets? Bombay HC Rule Explained
description: On Oct 15, 2026, the Bombay High Court said its ban on bursting crackers on public roads, streets, lanes and footpaths applies all year. Making and selling firecrackers is not banned. Sources: PTI, Bar & Bench, LawChakra. #Diwali2026 #Shorts

scenes.label: DIWALI 2026
scenes.spoken: Namaste! I am Deepu the Diya. Can you burst crackers outside your building this Diwali? Let me explain.

scenes.label: BOMBAY HIGH COURT, OCT 15
scenes.spoken: On October fifteenth, the Bombay High Court said its ban on bursting crackers on public roads, streets, lanes and footpaths applies all year.
scenes.caption: On October 15th, the Bombay High Court said its ban on bursting crackers on public roads, streets, lanes and footpaths applies all year.

scenes.label: THE FINE PRINT
scenes.spoken: Making and selling firecrackers is not banned. The rule is about bursting them in public places.

scenes.label: CELEBRATE SAFELY
scenes.spoken: So celebrate safely, light a diya, and share this with your family group. Happy Diwali!
